modules.summary: Pull-to-shoot gesture math. Pure functions: no DOM, no globals.
modules.notes: Units: pointer positions and distance share one unit (pixels); ratios are 0..1.

functions.name: pullRatio
functions.description: How far a drag has travelled along a track, clamped to 0..1.

params.name: start
params.description: Pointer position where the drag began.

params.name: distance
params.description: Track length in the same unit as the positions.

edge: A track length of 0 or less returns 0.

functions.name: shotStrength
functions.description: Power curve: gentle pulls stay gentle, full pulls reach 1.

params.name: ratio
params.description: Pull ratio; values outside 0..1 are clamped.

functions.name: reachesMinPull
functions.description: True when a released pull is long enough to shoot. Tolerates 1e-9 of float noise: an exact 5% pull computed from pixel coordinates can land at 0.04999999.

returns.description: Whether the pull reaches the minimum.

edge: Exactly the minimum shoots; anything clearly below does not.

constants.name: PULL
constants.description: Gesture thresholds: minimum pull ratio to shoot (0.05) and the power-curve exponent (1.5).

modules.summary: Clamp a number into the range min..max.

functions.name: clamp
functions.description: Limit a number to the inclusive range min..max.
edge: NaN in gives NaN out; arguments are not validated.
